_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: White sectional garage door and dry driveway at a modest Florida home
figures.caption: Start at the whole opening: driveway slope, slab condition, door travel, and where rainwater collects can matter as much as the rubber seal itself.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Garage door bottom weather seal meeting a concrete slab beside lower track hardware
figures.caption: A replacement seal needs a clean, even contact line across the slab. Gaps at either corner or a warped door edge can defeat a brand-new strip.

figures.alt: Downspout runoff directed through a rock-lined swale away from a Florida foundation
figures.caption: Water control outside the garage matters too. When roof runoff is sent away from the slab, a door-bottom seal is less likely to be asked to solve a grading problem.
